luiskr.com / experiments/star-field/engine/registry / parseRegistryId

function parseRegistryId(id): {
  kind: string
  rank: number
} | null

Defined in: experiments/star-field/engine/registry.ts:89

Splits a registry id into its kind and global rank — the two numbers the shard math needs (shard = rank ÷ shardSize, slot = rank mod shardSize). Returns null on malformed ids.

Parameters

id

string

Registry id (star-000042).

Returns

| { kind: string; rank: number; } | null

{ kind, rank } or null.
